name: CRACK_MAM
comment: MAM: joystick and keyboard control, and its own removal of the disk protection. The IRQ calls MAM code at $0829 in the BASIC file of MAM: that code is not in the program, so a MAM build needs the BASIC file of the MAM disk.

name: CRACK_MAM
comment: MAM: joystick and keyboard control, and its own removal of the disk protection. The IRQ calls MAM code at $0829 in the first page of the MAM file KOALAPAINTER ($0801-$08ff): that page is not in the program of the knowledge, so a MAM build needs that file.

name: CRACK_TBC
comment: TBC: the joystick routine at $4800, which the TBC loader KP hooks into the IRQ in joystick mode. MAM ends at $47ff, so the bytes of the original program at $4800-$4838 are not known: without TBC, the build has zero bytes there.

name: PROTECTION
comment: Disk protection of the start-up: the start-up script (op 9 at $1e30) jumps to $3a43, which tests RAM at $8413 and reads track 1 sectors 1 and 2 with U1 commands. TBC put NOPs over the checks after the reads (the original bytes are in no release). MAM put NOPs over the reads too (CRACK_MAM). Off: the script ends at $1e30.
